name: dojo-kit
description: Generic exam-trainer framework: build offline study apps from course content.
author: Camarent

scripts.test:final: for f in workspace/*/tests/final-tests.txt; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bash scripts/course-test.sh "${f%/tests/final-tests.txt}" final || exit 1; done
scripts.audit:js: knip --no-config-hints && madge --circular --extensions js web modules && jscpd web modules --min-lines 10 --min-tokens 70 --threshold 5 --ignore "**/vendor/**,**/tests/**" --silent && node tools/audit-gate.js
